verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only bank feeds on the Pro Plan: auto-importing, merging and categorizing bank transactions. Nothing documents a per-account reconciliation against the ledger or a review surface for matched, unmatched or duplicate transactions. Auto-merge and categorization are a related bank-feed feature, not the reconciliation workflow this story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review
